name: smwpatches-horizontal-scroll-fix-v1
title: Horizontal Scroll Fix v1.1
description:
If the player starts the level too far to the right, the screen starts with him centered, not with him to the right. When the level scrolls, the camera suddenly jumps, and cutoffness appears nearby.

This patch fixes that bug.

Update: Now should work with v3.00 of Lunar Magic.
Update 2: Do not use in version v3.01+ of Lunar Magic, as the patch is now built into LM.
